description: This PHP source file defines the class 'jirarestInterface', which implements an interface for interacting with Jira REST API as part of an issue tracker integration system. It includes methods for connecting to Jira, retrieving, creating, updating issues, and managing Jira-specific attributes.

classes.name: jirarestInterface
classes.description: A class implementing Jira REST API interaction for issue tracking integration, including methods for connection, issue retrieval, creation, commenting, and attribute management.

methods.name: getIssueAttr
methods.description: Returns the stored issue attributes.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and normalizes the configuration properties for API URLs and other settings.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the internal API client object.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the issue ID syntax is valid.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Jira and verifies access.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Jira is active.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific issue from Jira.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a given issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a human-readable status description for a given issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string summarizing the issue.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a bug ID exists in Jira.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Jira with specified summary, description, and options.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment (note) to a Jira issue.

methods.name: getIssueTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of issue types from Jira.

methods.name: getPriorities
methods.description: Retrieves the list of priorities from Jira.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves available versions for the project from Jira.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves project components from Jira.

methods.name: getCreateIssueFields
methods.description: Retrieves fields required for creating an issue in Jira.

methods.name: getIssueTypesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns issue types formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: getPrioritiesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns priorities formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: getVersionsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns versions formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: getComponentsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns components formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: objectAttrToIDName
methods.description: Converts a set of objects with id and name attributes into an associative array.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration XML for connecting to Jira.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Checks if the current configuration allows issue creation via API.

methods.name: processAttributes
methods.description: Processes custom attributes for issues from configuration.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsAttribute
methods.description: Parses and sets custom Jira fields based on configuration.

methods.name: checkCfg
methods.description: Validates the current configuration for connection and issue creation.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Sets the resolved status mapping based on configuration or defaults.

methods.name: getUserAccountID
methods.description: Retrieves Jira user account ID by email.
